name: Digilians Data Analysis Exam DNA V2

sourceTarget.rule: External-similar questions must apply concepts already taught in the material and must not introduce new syllabus concepts.

generationRules: Use exactly four MCQ options A-D with one correct answer.
Use realistic distractors from the same concept family; do not use obviously silly distractors.
Mix Easy, Medium and Hard questions instead of grouping them by difficulty.
Prioritize confusable concepts and operational details.
For code-capable topics, include multi-step tracing and realistic edge cases.
For visualization/BI topics, include scenario, best-decision, validation and troubleshooting questions.
Keep correct-answer positions approximately balanced across A/B/C/D.
Every question needs an Arabic explanation and source traceability.
External-similar questions may change scenario/data/code but may not introduce concepts outside the taught syllabus.
